build_id.description:
Build identity of the sending binary (design D3): the git short SHA
plus `-dirty` when the tree was dirty at build time. `#[serde(default)]`
keeps the field additive: a peer that predates it decodes an empty
value and is ignored by `PeerBuild::Any` handshakes.

control_token.description: Control credential used only when the peer advertises `control-auth`.

swap_token.description:
One-shot swap token carried only by a Client the Owner itself started
for a Pin swap. `None` for every Client the user started.
